report.clinical_summary: An older woman presents with significant fatigue, weakness, sleep disturbance, and panic-like symptoms (suffocation, lightheadedness) following the death of her husband six months ago. She has attempted self-care (diet, exercise) without improvement. She is open to medical investigation and treatment. No current prescription medications. Doctor has ordered blood work and ECG.
